authority.question: 是否授权我补齐这份正式验证方案供你确认？这一步仍不改原冻结源码和 F1、不分配实验种子、不启动采集，也不自动批准新判定规则。
authority.scope: integrated prospective draft and primary-agent internal review only

evidence_boundary.fixtures_v24_to_v26: mechanism construction evidence only; no population gain or sample N; do not rerun

locked_measurement.source: fresh A96 native F1 not A95

provenance.rationale: Retain the previously proposed 1.5 episode comparison margin before any scientific acquisition, without making the criterion easier after engineering runs. This is a declared benchmark target, not an independently validated minimum useful effect, cost-benefit threshold, or equivalence bound. Crossing it supports only the stated quantitative restricted-mean difference on the locked checkpoint grid; staying inside it is not practical equivalence. Its T-regime alias is a separate quantitative harm tolerance, not zero harm.

scientific_question: Given all real regime-specific Oracle credit, does one typed persistent update improve future recovery, retain improvement and avoid excessive unrelated or transient harm?

transient_population.source: original A62 canonical feasible world DGP
transient_population.support: all feasible worlds; normalize whole world rather than context-first rejection
transient_population.failure_only: COLLISION/TRAP/TIMEOUT; SUCCESS no reflection, ordinary TD remains
transient_population.zero_mass_table_policy: report absent structural mass; freeze registry before science; do not fabricate conditional mean
transient_population.empty_architecture_projection: preserve full Gamma and global stratum, explicit no-reflection/no-edit, two actual future clones; Collateral not applicable not zero

persistent_population_proposal.scope: new controlled finite family requiring review; not ratified reduction of original population

decision.contexts: all original decision_contexts with a legal strictly nonoptimal action
decision.action_distribution: independent uniform legal strictly nonoptimal actions

installation.D_Q: only bad-action Q entry = b+(b-q) from own original healthy reference; other entries unchanged
installation.D_patch: independent action patch from same external defect declaration and own healthy reference

controller.sites: original common-legal site domain with alternative command
controller.targets: uniform common-legal intersection minus original a_cmd

process.keys: uniform k-subset of original proposal keys
process.manifestation: ProcessCommit; at most one actual proposal owner per event, not installed k

persistent_population_proposal.trigger_selection: defect first, complete full-U2 factual census, original no-transient scene measure conditional on failure with nonempty full Gamma_P; do not weight defects by trigger count
persistent_population_proposal.nontrigger_policy: preserve all nontrigger worlds and report structural mass; P conditional estimand is new proposed population decision requiring explicit review
persistent_population_proposal.seed_aggregation: one cell defect/trigger per seed; all cell endpoints calculated first then weighted endpoint scalar; addresses/cells/architectures not independent seeds

generation_proposal.encoding: compact ASCII JSON array [namespace,seed,regime,cell,purpose,draw_index,rejection_counter] followed by LF
generation_proposal.integer_variate: unsigned SHA256 digest as 256-bit big-endian integer
generation_proposal.invalid: bool/float seed; M>2^256; exhausted rejection; no seed replacement or fallback
generation_proposal.weighted_rank: exact rational probabilities converted to integer intervals
generation_proposal.canonical_order: complete world and defect combination ranks
generation_proposal.future_CRN: original ExogenousEpisode.derive(seed,e) unchanged, paired arms and within-seed cells share episode-coordinate CRN

ceilings.locality_matched_L3: normalization ceiling diagnostic; aliases not additional independent treatments
ceilings.GlobalOracleRestore: constructional diagnostic only, not RecoveryFraction denominator

joint_ruler_proposal.definition: full U2 pre-success and no consultation of any declared owner in S; intersection of original E(c)
joint_ruler_proposal.per_site_diagnostics: same whole-update maps, not isolated causal effects or main aggregation
joint_ruler_proposal.total_domain: all distinct (architecture,full_pre_state,complete_S) possible with positive mass in whole proposed grammar; not arbitrary powerset or sampled seeds
joint_ruler_proposal.totality_certificate: complete enumeration extent or checkable structural proof plus explicit complete counterexample-search boundary
joint_ruler_proposal.empty_or_nonproper: preserve counterexample and block proposed design; no shrink S, imputation, world skip or current-scientific STOP
joint_ruler_proposal.feasibility: NOT_PROVEN; combinatorial scale and Process empty-healthy-region counterexamples possible; first later implementation task is feasibility, not collection

calibration_proposal.scope: every distinct production region with respective architecture including independent D_patch
calibration_proposal.injection: lexicographic first legal off-all-S site using original A89 scene/site order before viewing effect
calibration_proposal.D_Q: original factual action row to min(Q*)-1
calibration_proposal.D_patch: first off-S native Decision owner in pre trace, smallest legal strictly nonoptimal action
calibration_proposal.no_legal_site_or_zero_aggregate_predicti: uncertified; do not switch site or amplitude
calibration_proposal.independent_predictor: full pre-state and declared edit using original step/return semantics; preserve all other defects; never copy measured maps or substitute healthy continuation

delta_joint_proposal.domain: pre-only total production census of all distinct (A,W_pre,S), all four architectures/all cells, one spread per instance not scientific sample frequency
delta_joint_proposal.spread: ordered population SD of raw pre values on joint region; explicit constant=0; no sum/sumsq reconstruction
delta_joint_proposal.formula: nearest-rank 95th percentile; rank ceil(0.95*M); no interpolation or fit
delta_joint_proposal.all_zero_nonfinite_nonpositive: undefined proposed bound; no fabricated positive number
delta_joint_proposal.intractable_total_census: uncertified; no sample approximation or automatic baseline seeds
delta_joint_proposal.absolute_loss: report raw maps, not undeclared second pass gate

training.interim_100_200_300: diagnostic only cumulative and fresh100; only final look inferential

statistical_proposal.inferential_unit: independent seed; exactly one paired endpoint scalar per seed per declared row

bootstrap.reset: once per cohort for complete report; same saved index matrix across every row in that cohort, no dependence on row or worker completion order

formal_tests.sign: two-sided exact binomial on nonzero count
formal_tests.Wilcoxon: two-sided conditional exact signed rank with average tie ranks and zero-wilcox
formal_tests.formal_sign_family: all ordered rows across both cohorts
formal_tests.companion_Wilcoxon_family: same complete ordered rows, mandatory report not additional significance gate
formal_tests.diagnostic_sign_family: all unshifted rows separately, p identities never conflated
formal_tests.structural_zero_mass: regenerate exact closed family before freeze from mass proof, not science outcomes

degeneracy_proposal.all_zero_formal_vector: analytic p=1 DEGENERATE_NO_EVIDENCE, retained in family; new proposal not edits to old null candidate
degeneracy_proposal.unshifted_all_ties: unresolved direction; dz and zero-net top5 null
degeneracy_proposal.zero_SD: real constant bootstrap CI, no fabricated SD

statistical_proposal.positive_claim: CI strict margin + formal Holm-sign + raw mean/median/5%-each-tail trim improvement + unshifted complete diagnostic Holm-sign consistent + top5 same-direction contribution/net<0.50, report delete-top5 mean
statistical_proposal.noninferiority: inclusive CI bound + same direction/sign/trim/tail guards on offset vector; all raw diagnostics reported; not positive benefit, equivalence or zero harm
statistical_proposal.seed_improvement_fraction: count(d>0)/N including ties in denominator, not bootstrap mean-positive probability
statistical_proposal.family_generation_assumption: all three original T strata have positive mass; final actual member IDs frozen from complete pre-science mass proof

version_conclusion_proposal.anchor_selection: new prospective rule, not original A79 automatic authority
version_conclusion_proposal.core_support: primary final400 weighted P four-endpoint conjunction plus all positive-mass T harm constraints and full multiplicity/direction/tail guards; wait entire primary400 and secondary200 final report
version_conclusion_proposal.other_primary_mechanisms: separate D_patch/X results cannot rescue core anchor
version_conclusion_proposal.stronger_all_cell_support: only if every cell separately meets complete required criteria

staged_prerequisites: review concrete scientific proposals without treating draft as adoption
separate addon implementation authority and first total-domain feasibility/counterexample certification
complete original serial gates/regression with only original 1 skip, addon adversarial checks, stable post-mutation source hashes and source-bound review
total ruler calibration and pre-only bound certification, no F1 reopen
separately authorized fresh engineering keys and actual complete dense workload/resources, no prefix extrapolation
full local preregistration/addon inventory/population/weights/reference/family/statistics/resources/keyfiles commits and separately explicit science/collection scope; one-time gate
complete native workers, receipts, raw checkpoints/maps/ledgers/incidence, compressed and canonical SHA and stable source gates; ordered index-last publication
complete final analysis and unique-ledger closure before ending heartbeat

execution_constraints.abort_bound: 2*(T_suite+10*T_stage_workload), not ETA; exact workload extent must be frozen before run

interruption_policy: preserve reservation and incomplete evidence, external observation only, no forged native exit, automatic rerun, overwrite or replacement seeds; invalid post-collection bug evidence retained and new version/keys require new authority
next_authority: explicit implementation of independent addon and engineering verification; still not science collection authority
